paired_run_rule: Every case records reset state and hash before settling; candidate repair claims require matched old/new hashes and paired response comparison.

runtime_physics.note: Runtime fields are captured when exposed by this installed API; NA is not inferred from config.

drive_config.integral_gain_status: uncalibrated simulation candidate; not real motor/controller calibration
drive_config.drivetrain_note: Torque and RPM are idealized proxy-equivalent values: one motor per side, unit efficiency, 60 mm active sprocket, and 45 mm proxy support rollers. The 2 Nm per-wheel effort cap is not a measured motor rating.

worlds.coefficient_basis: same authored local +Y axis and same 0.045 m radius; confirm runtime axes before execution
worlds.construction_api: public ModelBuilder.add_custom_values; no private Newton helper

solver_equality_audit.note: MuJoCo equality constraints are solver constraints; finite residuals are measured at runtime and are not assumed identically zero.
